internal_acceptance.note: This Run selected the matching web-keep suite. Unlike the earlier lite Keep routing issue, the dominant Phase 3 risk here is repair non-convergence and execution budget fragmentation, not a suite identity mismatch.

octos_events.error_class: One turn/error with upstream HTTP 400 proxy_error; four additional unique flow failures are octos turn timeouts without a turn/error closure

runner_events.runner_final_state: completed with 32 designed, 31 implemented and 12 nodes not verified

metering.note: Platform token count and provider totals are different accounting scopes and are not added together.

official_tests.value: final Playwright report with 32 requirement-derived specs

conclusions.primary_confirmed_execution_issue: Four unique Octos turns ended by the 900-second or equivalent turn timeout path, one generation turn failed with an upstream proxy_error, and request-budget guards repeatedly forced turns to finish before repair verification.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_runner_issue: The runner completed its lifecycle but reported twelve nodes not verified after two full-suite repair turns; runner completion is not a passing result.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_platform_symptom: The final official suite reached the application and produced ten Playwright timeouts plus one screenshot assertion failure, concentrated in note actions, labels, settings and view-toggle state.
conclusions.implementation_root_cause_status: Exact final-template code causes remain Phase 4 read-only diagnosis work; Phase 3 does not infer DOM or data bugs from these symptoms alone.
conclusions.high_consumption_non_convergence: 458597168 platform tokens and 21858 seconds did not produce a passing result; repair convergence, not token volume, is the relevant optimization target.

optimization_candidates.action: Keep the matching task suite but fail closed when the acceptance runner cannot resolve /workspace/tests; make suite identity and official test root explicit in the run contract.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents hidden test-discovery drift while preserving the correct web-keep routing in this Run.

optimization_candidates.action: Use one small inspect -> patch -> targeted official-spec test loop per node and reserve a bounded repair budget; stop after repeated tool/path/protected-file guards.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces the four turn timeouts, 16 request-budget guards and late unverified nodes.

optimization_candidates.action: Run a clean-seed, workers=1 smoke for each failed cluster before cumulative repair; verify actual accessible names, visibility, DOM stability and persisted state.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Separates real UI contract defects from shared-state or detach/re-render effects.

optimization_candidates.action: Add provider retry/backoff with a bounded fallback for transient proxy_error, without spending the remaining node budget on repeated full rewrites.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Limits the impact of the single upstream HTTP/2 connection failure.

optimization_candidates.action: Make server/browser/process cleanup per turn and alert when process count accumulates; investigate the 672 postflight reaped processes separately.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Improves run hygiene and reduces environmental noise; it is not proven as the final application root cause.
